title: Redundant String Conversions
pattern: Invoking `.to_string()` or `.to_str()` repeatedly on a value that is already of the target string type.
why_bad: Wastes heap memory allocations and CPU cycles executing useless conversion pipelines that yield the exact same value.
detection: Calling string conversion methods on objects whose underlying static type is already `String` or `&str` respectively.
counterexample: Converting a custom struct that implements `ToString` into a String.
